events.name: Bash
events.head: Find patch file and references
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/ | grep -i unipile; grep -rIl "fix_bug-1-unipile" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . | head; grep -ric unipile workshop-plan/index.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: List tracked references to old name
events.input: $ git grep -n "fix_bug-1-unipile" -- ':!workshop-plan/tasks' ':!live' | cut -c1-200; ls -la live | head -3; git check-ignore live && echo ignored

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rename patch, update refs, rebuild hub
events.input: $ D=workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2 && git mv $D/fix_bug-1-unipile-account-id-regex--f7ef2beb53.patch $D/fix_bug-1-linkedin-account-id-regex--f7ef2beb53.patch && for f in workshop-plan/bugs/bugs.json workshop-plan/bugs/found/bug-1.json workshop-plan/bugs/metrics.json workshop-plan/bugs/report-2026-10-09.md workshop-plan/pipeline/local_pilot.json workshop-plan/pipeline/local_pilot.sh workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md; do sed -i '' 's/fix_bug-1-unipile-account-id-regex--f7ef2beb53\.patch/fix_bug-1-linkedin-account-id-regex--f7ef2beb53.patch/g' $f; done; git di

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check regenerated hub diff
events.input: $ git diff --stat workshop-plan/index.html; grep -ic unipile workshop-plan/index.html; git diff workshop-plan/index.html | grep -o "fix_bug-1-[a-z-]*" | sort | uniq -c
